ethics_approval_reference: <approval / exemption reference from the institutional ethics committee or the head of department's written authorisation>
consent_procedure: <how informed consent was obtained (information sheet version, date range, who collected it); how withdrawal works>
purpose: <authorised educational purpose, e.g. measuring agreement between AnswerWise AI suggestions and teacher marks for course 221601906>
data_controller: <role responsible for the data, e.g. course coordinator (not a personal email)>
retention_until: <YYYY-MM-DD: date after which raw answers and marks are deleted>
deletion_procedure: <what is deleted, how, and who confirms it; which aggregate results may be kept>
pseudonymisation: <who holds the key linking answer ids to students (or 'no key kept'); where it is stored; it never enters this directory>
manual_pii_review: <role of the person who read every answer for identifying details after check-pii, and the date>
adjudication: <who resolves disagreements (third teacher or consensus meeting) and how reasons are recorded>
